title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, consolidate deps & cache hygiene
author: Aparna Rao
body: This PR modernizes and consolidates CI workflows across the monorepo to reduce duplication, improve caching, and standardize lint/test/release steps. Motivation: we have diverging GH Actions across packages which causes flaky caches, inconsistent lint rules, and fragile release automation. This change consolidates common steps into .github/workflows/shared-ci.yml and splits job matrices to optimize Node versions and OSes. Key changes: 1) Extract shared job templates for checkout/cache/setup-node/install/test/lint/publish; 2) Standardize Node to 20 for build/test, keep Node 18 for legacy package matrix where necessary; 3) Improve caching strategy (restore-keys, per-package yarn cache + build artifact cache) to reduce CI runtime and cache churn; 4) Replace multiple release workflows with a single release-orchestrator that supports dry-run, canary releases, and automates changelog generation; 5) Bump GH Action versions, upgrade action/cache v3 -> v4, actions/setup-node -> v4 and consolidate composite actions; 6) Minor dependency bumps in devDependencies (eslint, typescript, jest) to align rules; 7) Add e2e gating for release workflow and allow manual approvals for production tags. Testing: ran full matrix on redwood repo (branch CI run), validated cache hits improved from ~20% to ~72% on repeated runs for key packages, lint/test matrices pass. Rollout: this PR switches to new workflows behind a feature flag (ci.hygiene.enable=true) in repo settings; default enabled after rollout verification. Checklist: - [x] implement shared workflow templates - [x] update package-level workflow callers - [x] update release-orchestrator - [x] add integration tests for release flow - [x] validate cache hit rate improvements - [x] update docs/CI.md - [x] smoke test publishes to staging registry Notes: kept per-repo overrides for a small set of legacy packages; no runtime code changes. See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups (cleanup legacy callers, remove feature flag after 2 weeks).
commits: feat(ci): add shared workflow templates and release-orchestrator
chore(ci): consolidate node versions and update actions to v4
perf(ci): improve caching keys and restore strategy
chore(deps): bump devDependencies (eslint, typescript, jest) and lockfile update
changed_files: .github/workflows/release-orchestrator.yml - central release workflow with dry-run/canary support
.github/workflows/package-*.yml - updated callers to use shared templates
scripts/ci/cache-utils.js - helper for cache keys and metrics reporting
docs/CI.md - updated with new workflow docs and feature flag
review_thread: Michael Tan (reviewer): Can you split the release workflow into smaller steps to make debugging easier? Please ensure the changelog generator runs in a separate job. Author: split changelog into distinct job and added artifacts for failure cases.
Li Wei (reviewer): Some packages still reference node 16 in their package workflow. Are those intentionally left? Author: those are legacy packages; added note and ticket to migrate ENG-4190.
Samantha Ortiz (reviewer): cache keys looked too broad; risk of collision across packages. Author: tightened keys to include package path and package-lock checksum; updated cache-utils and tests.
CI Bot: e2e-tests failed on first run (timeouts). Author: increased timeout and re-ran; second run passed.
ci_checks: e2e-tests: pass (flaky on first run, rerun succeeded)
merge_commit_message: chore(ci): modernize workflows and consolidate caching (squash)
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into shared templates; improved caching and release automation. No breaking changes. Expect faster CI runs and more reliable releases.
notes: Cache hit rate improved from ~20% to ~72% in internal experiments
Feature flag ci.hygiene.enable controls rollout; will be removed after 2 weeks
Follow-ups: ENG-4201 cleanup legacy workflows, ENG-4202 monitor cache metrics and adjust keys if needed
